metadata.title: Stocks to Watch: Nvidia, CrowdStrike, Salesforce

content.text:
LIVE
4 hours ago
Stocks to Watch: Nvidia, CrowdStrike, Salesforce
↗️ Nvidia (NVDA): Shares of the world’s most valuable company jumped 7% premarket after the chip maker said it expects 70% revenue growth in the company’s 2028 fiscal year.
↗️ Super Micro Computer (SMCI), Marvell Technology (MRVL), Sandisk (SNDK), Micron Technology (MU): Shares of other companies tied to AI are getting a premarket boost from Nvidia’s earnings.
↗️ CrowdStrike (CRWD): Growing cybersecurity demand from AI adoption propelled the company to what it described as its best quarter on record. Shares jumped 8% premarket.
